map.：建面 100㎡、使用 82㎡ → 得房率 82%（优秀 s5）；面宽 10、进: Gross 100 sqm, interior 82 sqm -> usable-area ratio 82% (excellent s5); width 10, depth 12, depth-to-width ratio 1.2 (fairly square, s4) -> composite = 5*0.5 + 4*0.5 = 4.5, excellent.
map.：若使用仅 65㎡、得房率 65%（偏低 s2）、进深面宽比 2.0（偏长 s3: If it is only 65 sqm with a 65% usable-area ratio (low, s2) and a depth-to-width ratio of 2.0 (too long, s3), then composite = 2*0.5 + 3*0.5 = 2.5, which is poor; better to avoid it.
